hooks.command: $j = ($input -join '') | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and $f -match 'requirements') { $result = python -m pip_audit 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $out = @{hookSpecificOutput = @{hookEventName = 'PostToolUse'; additionalContext = "pip-audit found vulnerabilities: $result"}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } }
